V. Cor mundum crea in me, Deus.
R. Et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
V. Ne projícias me a fácie tua.
R. Et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
V. Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui.
R. Et spíritu principáli confírma me.
Prayer Preces dominicales primae.eng:
V. But I, O Lord, have cried unto thee: 
R. And in the morning my prayer shall rise to thee
V. Let my mouth be filled with praise
R. That I may sing thy glory and thy greatness all the day long.
V. O Lord, turn away thy face from my sins
R. And blot out all my iniquities. 
V. Create a clean heart in me, O God 
R. And renew a right spirit within me.
V. Cast me not away from thy presence
R. And take not thy Holy Spirit from me.
V. Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation
R. And strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

Prayer Preces dominicales secundae.label: Preces dominicales secundae
Prayer Preces dominicales secundae.lat:
V. Dignáre, Dómine, die isto.
R. Sine peccáto nos custodíre.
V. Miserére nostri, Dómine.
R. Miserére nostri.
V. Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos.
R. Quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
Prayer Preces dominicales secundae.eng:
V. Vouchsafe, O Lord, 
R. To keep us this day without sin.
V. O Lord, have mercy upon us. 
R. Have mercy upon us.
V. O Lord, let thy mercy lighten upon us. 
R. As our trust is in thee.

Prayer Preces feriales Laudes.label: Preces feriales Laudes
Prayer Preces feriales Laudes.lat:
V. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
R. Sana ánimam meam quia peccávi tibi.
V. Convértere, Dómine, úsquequo? 
R. Et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
V. Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos.
R. Quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
V. Sacerdótes tui induántur justítiam.
R. Et sancti tui exsúltent.
V. Orémus pro beatíssimo Papa nostro r. N.
R. Dóminus consérvet eum, et vivíficet eum, et beátum fáciat eum in terra, et non tradat eum in ánimam inimicórum ejus.
V. Orémus et pro Antístite nostro r. N.
R. Stet et pascat in fortitúdine tua, Dómine, in sublimitáte nóminis tui.
/:Romæ præcedens Versus cum suo Responsorio omittitur; alibi vero ad litteram N. ab omnibus nomen diœcesani Episcopi exprimatur, Vacante Apostolica vel Episcopali Sede, alteruter vel uterque respectivus Versus cum suo Responsorio præteritur.:/ 
V. Dómine, salvum fac regem.
R. Et exáudi nos in die, qua invocavérimus te.
V. Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.
R. Et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
V. Meménto Congregatiónis tuæ.
R. Quam possedísti ab inítio.
V. Fiat pax in virtúte tua.
R. Et abundántia in túrribus tuis.
V. Orémus pro benefactóribus nostris.
R. Retribúere dignáre, Dómine, ómnibus, nobis bona faciéntibus propter nomen tuum, vitam ætérnam.  Amen. 
V. Orémus pro fidélibus defúnctis.
R. Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine, et lux perpétua lúceat eis.
V. Requiéscant in pace.
R. Amen.
V. Pro frátribus nostris abséntibus.
R. Salvos fac servos tuos, Deus meus, sperántes in te.
V. Pro afflíctis et captívis.
R. Líbera eos, Deus Israël, ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus suis.
V. Mitte eis, Dómine, auxílium de sancto.
R. Et de Sion tuére eos.
V. Dómine, Deus virtútum, convérte nos.
R. Et osténde fáciem tuam, et salvi érimus.
V. Exsúrge, Christe, ádjuva nos.
R. Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.
Prayer Preces feriales Laudes.eng:
V. I said: Lord, be merciful unto me: 
R. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.
V. Turn thee again, O Lord; how long will it be? 
R. And be gracious unto thy servants. 
V. Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us.
R. As we have hoped in thee.
V. Let thy priests be clothed with justice: 
R. And may thy saints rejoice.
V. Let us pray for our most blessed Pope r. N.
R. The Lord preserve him and give him life, and make him blessed upon the earth: and deliver him not up to the will of his enemies. 
V. Let us pray for our bishop r. N.
R. May he stand firm and care for us in the strength of the Lord, in the might of thy name.
/:In Rome, the preceding Versicle and its Response are omitted.  Elsewhere, the name of the local Ordinary is inserted at the letter N.  If the Holy See or the See of the local Bishop is vacant, the appropriate V. and R., either or both as the case may be, is omitted.:/
V. O Lord, save our leaders.
R. And mercifully hear us when we call upon thee.
V. O Lord, save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: 
R. Govern them and lift them up for ever.
V. Remember thy congregation, 
R. Which thou hast possessed from the beginning. 
V. Let peace be in thy strength:
R. And abundance in thy towers.
V. Let us pray for our benefactors.
R. O Lord, for thy name's sake, deign to reward with eternal life all who do us good. Amen.
V. Let us pray for the faithful departed.
R. Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them.
V. May they rest in peace.
R. Amen.
V. Let us pray for our absent brothers.
R. Save thy servants, O God, who put their trust in thee.
V. Let us pray for the afflicted and imprisoned.
R. Deliver them, God of Israel, from all their tribulations.
V. O Lord, send them help from thy sanctuary.
R. And defend them out of Sion. 
V. Turn us again, O Lord, God of Hosts.
R. Show us thy face, and we shall be whole.
V. Arise, O Christ, and help us.
R. And redeem us for thy name's sake.

Prayer Preces feriales Prima.label: Preces feriales Prima
Prayer Preces feriales Prima.lat:
V. Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo.
R. A viro iníquo éripe me.
V. Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
R. Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
V. Éripe me de operántibus iniquitátem.
R. Et de viris sánguinum salva me.
V. Sic psalmum dicam nómini tuo in sǽculum sǽculi.
R. Ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.
V. Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster.
R. Spes ómnium fínium terræ, et in mari longe.
V. Deus in adjutórium meum inténde.
R. Dómine, ad adjuvándum me festína.
V. Sanctus Deus, Sanctus fortis, Sanctus immortális.
R. Miserére nobis.
V. Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
R. Et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto ejus.
V. Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
R. Et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes ejus.
V. Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis.
R. Qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
V. Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam.
R. Qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
V. Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum.
R. Renovábitur ut áquilæ juvéntus tua.
Prayer Preces feriales Prima.eng:
V. Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man.
R. Rescue me from the unjust man.
V. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.
R. And defend me from them that rise up against me.
V. Deliver me from them that work iniquity.
R. And save me from bloody men.
V. So will I sing a psalm to thy name for ever and ever.
R. That I may pay my vows from day to day.
V. Hear us, O God our saviour.
R. Who art the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of the sea afar off.
V. O God come to my assistance;
R. O Lord, make haste to help me.
V. O holy God, Oh holy strength, Oh holy and immortal one.
R. Have mercy on us.
V. Bless the Lord, O my soul.
R. And let all that is within me bless his holy name.
V. Bless the Lord, O my soul.
R. And forget not all his benefits.
V. Who forgives all thy iniquities.
R. Who heals all thy infirmities.
V. Who has redeemed thy life from destruction.
R. Who crowns thee with mercy and compassion.
V. Who satisfies thy desire with good things.
R. Thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle's.

V. Exsúrge, Christe, ádjuva nos.
R. Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.
V. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
R. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
Prayer Preces feriales minora.eng:
V. Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts:
R. Show us thy face, and we shall be saved.
V. Arise, O Christ, and help us
R. And deliver us for thy name's sake.
V. O Lord, hear my prayer:
R. And let my cry come unto thee.

Feria Ant 2 (feria 7).label: Antiphon
Feria Ant 2 (feria 7).lat: Illúmina, Dómine, * sedéntes in ténebris et umbra mortis, et dírige pedes nostros in viam pacis.
Feria Ant 2 (feria 7).eng: O Lord, give light * to those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, and guide our feet into the way of peace.

Feria Ant 3 (feria 7).label: Antiphon
Feria Ant 3 (feria 7).lat: Suscépit Deus * Israël, púerum suum: sicut locútus est ad Ábraham, et semen ejus usque in sǽculum.
Feria Ant 3 (feria 7).eng: God hath received * Israel his servant: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

Feria Versum 3 (feria 7).label: Versicle
Feria Versum 3 (feria 7).lat: ℣. Vespertína orátio ascéndat ad te, Dómine.
Feria Versum 3 (feria 7).latR: ℟. Et descéndat super nos misericórdia tua.
Feria Versum 3 (feria 7).eng: ℣. Let the evening prayer ascend unto thee, O Lord.
Feria Versum 3 (feria 7).engR: ℟. And let there descend upon us thy mercy.

Feria Vespera (feria 7).label: Capitulum
Feria Vespera (feria 7).lat: O Altitúdo divitiárum sapiéntiæ, et sciéntiæ Dei, quam incomprehensibília sunt judícia ejus, et investigábiles viæ ejus!
Feria Vespera (feria 7).eng: O the depth of the riches of the wisdom and of the knowledge of God! How incomprehensible are his judgments, and how unsearchable his ways!

Prayer benedictio Completorium|1955.label: benedictio Completorium
Prayer benedictio Completorium|1955.lat:
V. Jube, domne, benedícere.
Benedictio. Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.
Prayer benedictio Completorium|1955.eng:
V. Grant, Lord, a blessing.
Benedictio. May almighty God grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.

Prayer benedictio Prima|1955.label: benedictio Prima
Prayer benedictio Prima|1955.lat:
V. Jube, domne, benedícere.
Benedictio. Dies et actus nostros in sua pace dispónat Dóminus omnípotens.
R. Amen.
Prayer benedictio Prima|1955.eng:
V. Grant, Lord, a blessing.
Benedictio. May Almighty God arrange our deeds and our day in His peace. 
R. Amen.

Suffragium|pre1955.label: Suffragium
Suffragium|pre1955.lat:
Ant. Beáta Dei Génitrix Virgo María, Sanctíque omnes intercédant pro nobis ad Dóminum.
_
V. Mirificávit Dóminus Sanctos suos.
R. Et exaudívit eos clamántes ad se.
_
!Oratio
/:In hac oratione, ad litteram N. exprimitur nomen Titularis propriæ ecclesiæ, dummodo Titulus non sit Persona divina vel Mysterium Domini, aut de ipso ratione Festi factum non fuerit Officium vel Commemoratio, aut illius nomen non sit in eadem Suffragii Oratione expressum; ac nomina sanctorum Angelorum et sancti Joannis Baptistæ, si Titulares fuerint, præponuntur nomini sancti Joseph. In hisce autem omnibus casibus omittuntur verba «atque beáto N.»:/
$Oremus  
v. A cunctis nos, quǽsumus, Dómine, mentis et córporis defénde perículis: et, intercedénte beáta et gloriósa semper Vírgine Dei Genitríce María, cum beáto Joseph, beátis Apóstolis tuis Petro et Paulo, atque beáto N. et ómnibus Sanctis, salútem nobis tríbue benígnus et pacem; ut, destrúctis adversitátibus et erróribus univérsis, Ecclésia tua secúra tibi sérviat libertáte.
$Per eumdem
Suffragium|pre1955.eng:
Ant. May the Blessed Virgin Mary, Mother of God, and all the Saints intercede for us with the Lord.
_
V. The Lord hath made his holy one wonderful: 
R. The Lord will hear me when I cry unto him. 
_
!Prayer
/:At the letter N., the name of the Titular of the local church is said, if the title is not a divine person or a mystery of the Lord, and when the Office or a Commemoration was not already said of the Saint, and when the name is not already in the prayer. The names of the holy Angels and of St. John the Baptist, if they are titulars, are said before the name of St. Joseph. In all these cases, the words «blessed N.» are omitted.:/
$Oremus
v. O Lord, we ask thee to save us from dangers to mind and to body: and, by the intercession of the blessed and glorious Virgin Mother of God, blessed Joseph, the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, blessed r. N. and all the Saints, to eliminate all enmity and errors, that thy Church may safely serve thee in freedom.
$Per eumdem

Benedictio. May almighty God grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.

Day0 Laudes1.ant: Allelúja, * Dóminus regnávit, decórem índuit, allelúja, allelúja.
Day0 Laudes1.antEng: Alleluia, * The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty, alleluia, alleluia.
Shout with joy to God * all the earth, alleluia.

Day0 Laudes1.ant: Benedícam te * in vita mea, Dómine: et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas, allelúja.
Day0 Laudes1.antEng: I will bless thee all my life long * and in thy name I will lift up my hands, alleluia.

Day0 Laudes1.ant: Tres púeri * jussu regis in fornácem missi sunt, non timéntes flammam ignis, dicéntes: Benedíctus Deus, allelúja.
Day0 Laudes1.antEng: The three young boys * cast into the furnace by the king, fearing not the flames of fire, said: Blessed be God, alleluia.

Day0 Laudes1.ant: Allelúja, * laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúja, allelúja.
Day0 Laudes1.antEng: Alleluia, * praise ye the Lord from the heavens, alleluia, alleluia.

Day0 Vespera.ant: Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis.
Day0 Vespera.antEng: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand.

Day0 Vespera.ant: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes ejus.
Day0 Vespera.antEng: Great are the works of the Lord, * sought out according to all his wills.

Day0 Vespera.ant: Qui timet Dóminum, * in mandátis ejus cupit nimis.
Day0 Vespera.antEng: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

Day0 Vespera.ant: Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sǽcula.
Day0 Vespera.antEng: Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

Day0 Vespera.ant: Deus autem noster * in cælo: ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
Day0 Vespera.antEng: But our God is in heaven, * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

Day1 Laudes1.antEng: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

Day1 Laudes1.ant: Inténde * voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
Day1 Laudes1.antEng: Hearken to the voice * of my prayer, O my King and my God.

Day1 Laudes1.ant: Deus majestátis * intónuit: afférte glóriam nómini ejus.
Day1 Laudes1.antEng: The God of majesty * hath thundered, ascribe to the Lord glory to his name.

Day1 Laudes1.ant: Laudámus nomen tuum * ínclitum, Deus noster.
Day1 Laudes1.antEng: O God of majesty, * we praise thy glorious name.
O praise the Lord, * all ye nations.

Day1 Laudes2.ant: Miserére * mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
Day1 Laudes2.antEng: Have mercy on me, * O God, according to thy great mercy.

Day1 Laudes2.ant: Deduc me * in justítia tua, Dómine.
Day1 Laudes2.antEng: Conduct me, * O Lord, in thy justice.

Day1 Laudes2.ant: Dóminus dabit virtútem * et benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
Day1 Laudes2.antEng: God will give * power and strength to his people.

Day1 Laudes2.ant: Convérsus est furor tuus, * Dómine, et consolátus es me.
Day1 Laudes2.antEng: Thy wrath is turned away * and thou hast comforted me.

Day1 Laudes2.ant: Laudáte * Dóminum quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia ejus.
Day1 Laudes2.antEng: Praise * the Lord, for his mercy is confirmed upon us.

Day1 Laudes3.ant: Ecce véniet * Dóminus princeps regum terræ: beáti, qui parati sunt occúrrere illi.
Day1 Laudes3.antEng: Behold, the Lord cometh, * the Prince of the Kings of the earth: blessed are they that are ready to go forth to meet him.

Day1 Laudes3.ant: Cum vénerit * Fílius hóminis, putas invéniet fidem super terram?
Day1 Laudes3.antEng: When the Son of man cometh, * shall he find faith on the earth?

Day1 Laudes3.ant: Ecce jam venit * plenitúdo témporis, in quo misit Deus Fílium suum in terras.
Day1 Laudes3.antEng: Behold, the fulness * of the time is come, when God sent forth his Son into the world.

Day1 Laudes3.ant: Hauriétis aquas * in gáudio de fóntibus Salvatóris.
Day1 Laudes3.antEng: With joy * shall ye draw water out of the wells of the Saviour.

Day1 Laudes3.ant: Egrediétur * Dóminus de loco sancto suo: véniet ut salvet pópulum suum.
Day1 Laudes3.antEng: The Lord goeth forth * from his holy place he cometh to save his people.

Day1 Vespera.antEng: The Lord hath inclined * his ear unto me.

Day1 Vespera.ant: Vota mea * Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo ejus.
Day1 Vespera.antEng: I will pay my vows * in the sight of all his people.
I have cried to the Lord, * and he hath heard me.

Day1 Vespera.ant: Auxílium meum * a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
Day1 Vespera.antEng: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

Day1 Vespera.ant: Lætátus sum * in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi.
Day1 Vespera.antEng: I rejoiced * at the things that were said to me.

Day2 Laudes1.ant: Cantáte * Dómino et benedícite nómini ejus.
Day2 Laudes1.antEng: Sing ye * to the Lord and bless his name.
The salvation of my countenance * and my God.

Day2 Laudes1.ant: Illúmina, Dómine, * vultum tuum super nos.
Day2 Laudes1.antEng: May the Lord shine the light * of his countenance upon us.

Day2 Laudes1.ant: Exaltáte * Regem sæculórum in opéribus vestris.
Day2 Laudes1.antEng: Give ye glory to him * in your works.

Day2 Laudes1.ant: Laudáte * nomen Dómini, qui statis in domo Dómini.
Day2 Laudes1.antEng: Praise * the name of the Lord, ye who stand in the house of the Lord.

Day2 Laudes2.ant: Dele iniquitátem meam, * Dómine, secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum.
Day2 Laudes2.antEng: According to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

Day2 Laudes2.ant: Discérne causam meam, * Deus, de gente non sancta.
Day2 Laudes2.antEng: Distinguish my cause, O Lord, * from the nation that is not holy.

Day2 Laudes2.ant: Deus misereátur * nostri, et benedícat nobis.
Day2 Laudes2.antEng: May God have mercy on us * and bless us.

Day2 Laudes2.ant: Corrípies me, Dómine, * et vivificábis me.
Day2 Laudes2.antEng: Thou shalt correct me, O Lord, * and make me to live.

Day2 Laudes2.ant: Laudáte * Dóminum quia benígnus est, et in servis suis deprecábitur.
Day2 Laudes2.antEng: Praise * the Lord, for he will judge his people, and be gracious unto his servants.

Day2 Laudes3.ant: Roráte, cæli, désuper, * et nubes pluant justum: aperiátur terra, et gérminet Salvatórem.
Day2 Laudes3.antEng: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, * and let the skies pour down the Righteous One: let the earth open and bring forth the Saviour.

Day2 Laudes3.ant: Emítte Agnum, Dómine, * Dominatórem terræ, de Petra desérti, ad montem fíliæ Sion.
Day2 Laudes3.antEng: Send forth the Lamb, O Lord, * the Ruler of the land, from the rock of the wilderness unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

Day2 Laudes3.ant: Ut cognoscámus, Dómine, * in terra viam tuam, in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
Day2 Laudes3.antEng: That thy way, O Lord, * may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

Day2 Laudes3.ant: Da mercédem, Dómine, * sustinéntibus te, ut prophétæ tui fidéles inveniántur.
Day2 Laudes3.antEng: O Lord, * reward them that wait for thee, and let thy prophets be found faithful.

Day2 Laudes3.ant: Lex per Móysen data est, * grátia et véritas per Jesum Christum facta est.
Day2 Laudes3.antEng: The law was given by Moses, * but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

Day2 Vespera.ant: Qui hábitas in cælis, * miserére nobis.
Day2 Vespera.antEng: Thou who dwellest in heaven, * have mercy on us.
Our help is * in the name of the Lord.

Day2 Vespera.ant: In circúitu pópuli sui * Dóminus, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
Day2 Vespera.antEng: The Lord standeth round his people * from this time forth and for evermore.

Day2 Vespera.ant: Magnificávit Dóminus * fácere nobíscum: facti sumus lætántes.
Day2 Vespera.antEng: The Lord hath * done great things for us, whereof we rejoice.

Day2 Vespera.ant: Dóminus ædíficet * nobis domum, et custódiat civitátem.
Day2 Vespera.antEng: The Lord builds * the house and keeps the city.

Day3 Laudes1.antEng: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice.

Day3 Laudes1.ant: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion.
Day3 Laudes1.antEng: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion.

Day3 Laudes1.ant: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
Day3 Laudes1.antEng: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

Day3 Laudes1.ant: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
Day3 Laudes1.antEng: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

Day3 Laudes1.ant: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
Day3 Laudes1.antEng: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

Day3 Laudes2.ant: Ámplius lava me, * Dómine, ab injustítia mea.
Day3 Laudes2.antEng: O Lord, wash me * yet more from my iniquity.
O Lord, * thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

Day3 Laudes2.ant: In innocéntia * cordis mei perambulábo, Dómine.
Day3 Laudes2.antEng: I walked in the innocence * of my heart, O Lord.

Day3 Laudes2.ant: Exsultávit cor meum * in Dómino, qui humíliat et súblevat.
Day3 Laudes2.antEng: My heart hath rejoiced * in the Lord, he humbleth and he exalteth.

Day3 Laudes2.ant: Lauda * ánima mea Dóminum, qui érigit elísos et díligit justos.
Day3 Laudes2.antEng: Praise * the Lord my soul, he lifts up those who fall, and loves the just.

Day3 Laudes3.ant: Prophétæ prædicavérunt * nasci Salvatórem de Vírgine María.
Day3 Laudes3.antEng: The Prophets foretold * that the Saviour should be born of the Virgin Mary.

Day3 Laudes3.ant: Spíritus * Dómini super me, evangelizáre paupéribus misit me.
Day3 Laudes3.antEng: The Spirit of the Lord * is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the Gospel to the poor.

Day3 Laudes3.ant: Propter Sion * non tacébo, donec egrediátur ut splendor justus ejus.
Day3 Laudes3.antEng: For Zion's sake * will I not hold my peace, until her Righteous One goeth forth as brightness.

Day3 Laudes3.ant: Ecce, véniet Dóminus, * ut sédeat cum princípibus, et sólium glóriæ téneat.
Day3 Laudes3.antEng: Behold, the Lord cometh, * to sit among princes, and to inherit the throne of glory.

Day3 Laudes3.ant: Annuntiáte * pópulis, et dícite: Ecce, Deus Salvátor noster véniet.
Day3 Laudes3.antEng: Tell it out among the people, * and say: Behold, God, our Saviour cometh.

Day3 Vespera.antEng: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord.
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

Day3 Vespera.ant: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine.
Day3 Vespera.antEng: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord.

Day3 Vespera.ant: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum.
Day3 Vespera.antEng: O Lord * my heart is not exalted.

Day3 Vespera.ant: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
Day3 Vespera.antEng: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

Day4 Laudes1.antEng: Make a joyful noise * before the Lord our King.
Lord, * thou hast been our refuge.
O Lord, * thy mercy is in heaven.

Day4 Laudes1.ant: Pópulus meus, * ait Dóminus, bonis meis adimplébitur.
Day4 Laudes1.antEng: My people, * said the Lord, shall be filled with good things.
To our God * be joyful and fitting praise.

Day4 Laudes2.ant: Tibi soli peccávi, * Dómine, miserére mei.
Day4 Laudes2.antEng: Before thee only have I sinned, * O Lord, have mercy on me.

Day4 Laudes2.ant: Convértere, Dómine, * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
Day4 Laudes2.antEng: Turn thee again, O Lord, * and be gracious unto thy servants.
O God, * thou hast multiplied thy mercy.

Day4 Laudes2.ant: Fortitúdo mea * et laus mea Dóminus: et factus est mihi in salútem.
Day4 Laudes2.antEng: The Lord is my strength * and my praise, and he is become my salvation.

Day4 Laudes2.ant: Laudáte * Dóminum qui sanat contrítos corde, et álligat contritiónes eórum.
Day4 Laudes2.antEng: Praise the Lord * who healeth the broken of heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

Day4 Laudes3.ant: De Sion * véniet Dóminus omnípotens, ut salvum fáciat pópulum suum.
Day4 Laudes3.antEng: The Lord, the Almighty, * cometh out of Zion, to save his people.

Day4 Laudes3.ant: Convértere, Dómine, * aliquántulum, et ne tardes veníre ad servos tuos.
Day4 Laudes3.antEng: Turn thee, O Lord, * at the last, and tarry not to come unto thy servants.

Day4 Laudes3.ant: De Sion * véniet, qui regnatúrus est Dóminus, Emmánuel magnum nomen ejus.
Day4 Laudes3.antEng: The Lord that shall rule * shall come forth from Zion, Emmanuel is his name, and his name is great.

Day4 Laudes3.ant: Ecce Deus meus, * et honorábo eum: Deus patris mei, et exaltábo eum.
Day4 Laudes3.antEng: Behold, he is my God, * and I will glorify him: my father's God, and I will exalt him.

Day4 Laudes3.ant: Dóminus * légifer noster, Dóminus Rex noster, ipse véniet, et salvábit nos.
Day4 Laudes3.antEng: The Lord our Law-giver, * the Lord our King, he cometh and will save us.

Day4 Vespera.ant: Ecce quam bonum * et quam jucúndum habitáre fratres in unum.
Day4 Vespera.antEng: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity.

Day4 Vespera.ant: Confitémini Dómino * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
Day4 Vespera.antEng: Give ye glory to the Lord * for his mercy endureth for ever.

Day4 Vespera.ant: Confitémini Dómino * quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri.
Day4 Vespera.antEng: Give ye glory to the Lord * for he was mindful of us in our affliction.

Day4 Vespera.ant: Adhǽreat lingua mea * fáucibus meis, si non memínero tui Jerúsalem.
Day4 Vespera.antEng: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws * if I do not remember thee, Jerusalem.

Day4 Vespera.ant: Confitébor * nómini tuo, Dómine, super misericórdia et veritáte tua.
Day4 Vespera.antEng: I will give glory * to thy name, for thy mercy, and for thy truth.

Day5 Laudes1.ant: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto ejus.
Day5 Laudes1.antEng: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

Day5 Laudes1.ant: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
Day5 Laudes1.antEng: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

Day5 Laudes1.ant: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
Day5 Laudes1.antEng: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

Day5 Laudes1.ant: In Dómino justificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
Day5 Laudes1.antEng: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

Day5 Laudes2.ant: Cor contrítum * et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
Day5 Laudes2.antEng: A contrite and a humbled heart, * O God, thou wilt not despise.

Day5 Laudes2.ant: Propter nomen tuum, * Dómine, vivificábis me in æquitáte tua.
Day5 Laudes2.antEng: For thy name's sake, * O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

Day5 Laudes2.ant: Deus, tu convérsus * vivificábis nos, et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
Day5 Laudes2.antEng: Thou wilt turn, O God, * Thou wilt quicken us and bring us to life.

Day5 Laudes2.ant: Cum irátus fúeris, * Dómine, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
Day5 Laudes2.antEng: When thou art angry, * O Lord, thou wilt remember mercy.

Day5 Laudes2.ant: Lauda * Deum tuum, Sion, qui annúntiat judícia sua Israël.
Day5 Laudes2.antEng: Praise thy God, * O Sion, who declareth his judgments to Israel.

Day5 Laudes3.ant: Constántes estóte, * vidébitis auxílium Dómini super vos.
Day5 Laudes3.antEng: Stand still * and you shall see the salvation of the Lord.

Day5 Laudes3.ant: Ad te, Dómine, * levávi ánimam meam: veni, et éripe me, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
Day5 Laudes3.antEng: Unto thee, O Lord, * lift I up my soul; come and deliver me, O Lord, in thee do I put my trust.

Day5 Laudes3.ant: Veni, Dómine, * et noli tardáre: reláxa facínora plebi tuæ Israël.
Day5 Laudes3.antEng: Come, O Lord, * and make no tarrying; loosen the bonds of thy people Israel.

Day5 Laudes3.ant: Deus a Líbano véniet, * et splendor ejus sicut lumen erit.
Day5 Laudes3.antEng: God shall come from Lebanon, * and his brightness shall be as the light.

Day5 Laudes3.ant: Ego autem * ad Dóminum aspíciam, et exspectábo Deum Salvatórem meum.
Day5 Laudes3.antEng: Therefore I shall look unto the Lord, * I shall wait for God my Saviour.

Day5 Vespera.ant: Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me.
Day5 Vespera.antEng: Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me.

Day5 Vespera.ant: Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
Day5 Vespera.antEng: Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

Day5 Vespera.ant: Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
Day5 Vespera.antEng: Do not thou forsake me, * O Lord, the strength of my salvation.

Day5 Vespera.ant: Dómine, * clamávi ad te, exáudi me.
Day5 Vespera.antEng: I have cried to thee, * O Lord, hear me.

Day5 Vespera.ant: Educ de custódia * ánimam meam, Dómine, ad confiténdum nómini tuo.
Day5 Vespera.antEng: Bring my soul * out of prison, O Lord, that I may praise thy name.

Day6 Laudes1.ant: Fílii Sion * exsúltent in Rege suo.
Day6 Laudes1.antEng: Let the children of Sion * be joyful in their king.

Day6 Laudes1.ant: Quam magnificáta * sunt ópera tua, Dómine.
Day6 Laudes1.antEng: O Lord, * how great are thy works!

Day6 Laudes1.ant: Lætábitur justus * in Dómino et sperábit in eo.
Day6 Laudes1.antEng: The just shall rejoice * in the Lord, and shall hope in him.

Day6 Laudes1.ant: Osténde nobis, Dómine, * lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
Day6 Laudes1.antEng: Show us, O Lord, * the light of thy mercies.
Let every thing that hath breath * praise the Lord.

Day6 Laudes2.ant: Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
Day6 Laudes2.antEng: In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

Day6 Laudes2.ant: Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
Day6 Laudes2.antEng: The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

Day6 Laudes2.ant: A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
Day6 Laudes2.antEng: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

Day6 Laudes2.ant: In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
Day6 Laudes2.antEng: The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

Day6 Laudes2.ant: Laudáte * Dóminum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis ejus.
Day6 Laudes2.antEng: Praise ye the Lord * according to the excellence of his greatness.

Day6 Laudes3.ant: Intuémini * quam sit gloriósus iste, qui ingréditur ad salvándos pópulos.
Day6 Laudes3.antEng: Consider how glorious is the one * who shall bring about the salvation of the peoples.

Day6 Laudes3.ant: Multiplicábitur * ejus impérium, et pacis non erit finis.
Day6 Laudes3.antEng: His kingdom shall increase, * and of his peace there shall be no end.

Day6 Laudes3.ant: Ego Dóminus * prope feci justítiam meam, non elongábitur, et salus mea non morábitur.
Day6 Laudes3.antEng: I, the Lord, have brought my justice near, * it shall not be afar off, and my salvation shall not delay.

Day6 Laudes3.ant: Exspectétur, * sicut plúvia, elóquium Dómini: et descéndat, sicut ros, super nos Dóminus Deus noster.
Day6 Laudes3.antEng: May the speech of the Lord be awaited like rain: * and the Lord our God descend like dew upon us.

Day6 Laudes3.ant: Parátus esto * Israël, in occúrsum Dómini, quóniam venit.
Day6 Laudes3.antEng: Let Israel be ready * to go out to meet the Lord, for he is coming.

Day6 Vespera.ant: Benedíctus Dóminus * suscéptor meus et liberátor meus.
Day6 Vespera.antEng: Blessed be the Lord * my support, and my deliverer.

Day6 Vespera.ant: Beátus pópulus * cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
Day6 Vespera.antEng: Happy is that people * whose God is the Lord.

Day6 Vespera.ant: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
Day6 Vespera.antEng: For the Lord is great * and exceedingly to be praised: His greatness has no end.

Day6 Vespera.ant: Suávis Dóminus * univérsis: et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
Day6 Vespera.antEng: The Lord is sweet * to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

Day6 Vespera.ant: Fidélis Dóminus * in ómnibus verbis suis: et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
Day6 Vespera.antEng: The Lord is faithful * in all his words: and holy in all his works.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: Véniet ecce Rex * excélsus cum potestáte magna ad salvándas gentes, allelúja.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold, there cometh the King * even the Most High, with great power, to save the nations, alleluia.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: Confortáte * manus dissolútas: confortámini, dícite: Ecce Deus noster véniet, et salvábit nos, allelúja.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: Strengthen ye * the weak hands, be strong, say: Behold, our God will come, and save us, alleluia.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: Gaudéte omnes * et lætámini: ecce quia véniet Dóminus ultiónis addúcet retributiónem: ipse véniet, et salvábit nos.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: Rejoice * all ye, and be glad for, behold, the Lord will come with vengeance, He will bring a recompense He will come and save us.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.vEng: Out of Zion, the Perfection of beauty.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: Gaude et lætáre, * fília Jerúsalem: ecce Rex tuus véniet tibi: Sion, noli timére, quia cito véniet salus tua.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: Rejoice greatly, * O daughter of Jerusalem; behold, thy King cometh into thee, O Zion; fear not, for thy salvation cometh quickly.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: Rex noster * advéniet Christus, quem Joánnes prædicávit Agnum esse ventúrum.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: Christ our King cometh, * Whom John preached, saying: Behold the Lamb That should come!

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: Ecce vénio * cito et merces mea mecum est, dicit Dóminus: dare unicuíque secúndum ópera sua.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: Behold, I come * quickly, saith the Lord, and My reward is with Me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.r: De Petra desérti ad montem fíliæ Sion.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.vEng: Send forth the Lamb, O Lord, the ruler of the land.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.rEng: From the Rock of the wilderness unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: Gábriel Ángelus * locútus est Maríæ, dicens: Ave, grátia plena: Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu inter mulíeres.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: The Angel Gabriel * spake unto Mary, saying: Hail, thou that art full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: María dixit: * Putas qualis est ista salutátio, quia conturbáta est ánima mea, et quia paritúra sum Regem, qui claustrum virginitátis meæ non violábit?
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: Mary said: * What manner of salutation is this? My soul is troubled. Shall I bear the King? And will He not break the seal of my virginity?

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.ant: In advéntu * summi Regis mundéntur corda hóminum, ut digne ambulémus in occúrsum illíus: quia ecce véniet et non tardábit.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.antEng: The King, * even the Most High, cometh therefore let the hearts of men be purified to go forth to meet Him, for, behold, He will come and will not tarry.

Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.v: Egrediétur Dóminus de loco sancto suo.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.vEng: The Lord cometh out of His holy place.
Adv 0 Ant Matutinum.rEng: He will come and save His people.

Advm0.antEng: Christ our King cometh, * Whom John preached, saying Behold the Lamb That should come!

Advm0.ant: Ecce, vénio * cito et merces mea mecum est, dicit Dóminus: dare unicuíque secúndum ópera sua.
Advm0.antEng: Behold, I come * quickly, saith the Lord, and My reward is with Me, to give every man according as his work shall be

Advm0.r: De petra desérti ad montem fíliæ Sion.
Advm0.vEng: Send forth the Lamb, O Lord, the ruler of the land.
Advm0.rEng: From the Rock of the wilderness unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

Advm0.ant: Gábriel Ángelus * locútus est Maríæ, dicens: Ave, grátia plena; Dóminus tecum; Benedícta tu in mulíeres.
Advm0.antEng: The Angel Gabriel spake unto Mary, saying: * Hail, thou that art full of grace, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

Advm0.v: Egrediétur Dóminus de loco sancto suo.
Advm0.vEng: The Lord cometh out of His holy place.
Advm0.rEng: He will come and save His people.

Day0.ant: Beátus vir * qui in lege Dómini meditátur.
Day0.antEng: Blessed is the man * who studieth the law of the Lord.

Day0.ant: Servíte Dómino * in timóre, et exsultáte ei cum tremóre.
Day0.antEng: Serve ye the Lord * with fear: and rejoice unto him with trembling.

Day0.ant: Exsúrge, * Dómine, salvum me fac, Deus meus.
Day0.antEng: Arise, * O Lord; save me, O my God.

Day0.v: Memor fui nocte nóminis tui, Dómine.
Day0.vEng: In the night I have remembered thy name, O Lord.

Day0.ant: Quam admirábile * est nomen tuum, Dómine, in univérsa terra!
Day0.antEng: How admirable * is thy name, O Lord, in the whole earth!

Day0.ant: Sedísti super thronum * qui júdicas justítiam.
Day0.antEng: Thou hast sat on the throne * who judgest justice.
Arise, O Lord, * let not man prevail.

Day0.v: Média nocte surgébam ad confiténdum tibi.
Day0.vEng: I rose at midnight to give praise to thee.
Day0.rEng: For the judgments of thy justification.

Day0.antEng: Why, O Lord, * hast thou retired afar off?

Day0.ant: Exsúrge, * Dómine Deus, exaltétur manus tua.
Day0.antEng: Arise, O Lord God, * let thy hand be exalted.
The Lord is just * and He hath loved justice.

Day0.v: Prævenérunt óculi mei ad te dilúculo.
Day0.vEng: My eyes to thee have prevented the morning.
Day0.rEng: That I might meditate on thy words, O Lord.

Day1.ant: Dóminus de cælo * prospéxit super fílios hóminum.
Day1.antEng: The Lord hath looked down from heaven * upon the children of men.

Day1.ant: Qui operátur justítiam * requiéscet in monte sancto tuo, Dómine.
Day1.antEng: He who worketh justice * may rest on thy holy mountain, O Lord.

Day1.ant: Inclína, Dómine, * aurem tuam mihi, et exáudi verba mea.
Day1.antEng: O Lord, incline * thy ear to me, and hear my voice, my Lord.

Day1.r: Qui salvos facis sperántes in te.
Day1.rEng: Thou who savest them that trust in thee.

Day1.antEng: I will love thee, * O Lord, who art my strength.

Day1.ant: Retríbuet mihi Dóminus * secúndum justítiam meam.
Day1.antEng: The Lord will reward me * according to my justice.

Day1.ant: Vivit Dóminus * et benedíctus Deus salútis meæ.
Day1.antEng: The Lord liveth, * and blessed be my God, my salvation.

Day1.vEng: I will give glory to thee, O Lord, among the nations.
Day1.rEng: And I will sing a psalm to thy name.

Day1.ant: Exáudiat te * Dóminus in die tribulatiónis.
Day1.antEng: May the Lord hear * thee in the day of tribulation.

Day1.ant: Dómine, * in virtúte tua lætábitur rex.
Day1.antEng: The king rejoices * in Thy strength, O Lord.

Day1.ant: Exaltábo te, * Dómine, quóniam suscepísti me.
Day1.antEng: I will extol thee, * O Lord, for thou hast upheld me.

Day1.vEng: Sing to the Lord, O ye his saints.
Day1.rEng: And give praise to the memory of his holiness.

Day2.antEng: Overthrow, O Lord, * them that fight against me.

Day2.ant: Restítue ánimam meam * a malefáctis eórum, Dómine.
Day2.antEng: Rescue, O Lord, * my soul from their malice.

Day2.ant: Exsúrge, Dómine, * et inténde judício meo.
Day2.antEng: Arise, O Lord, * and be attentive to my judgment.

Day2.vEng: And my tongue shall meditate thy justice.
Day2.rEng: Thy praise all the day long, O Lord.

Day2.ant: Noli æmulári * in eo qui prosperátur et facit iniquitátem.
Day2.antEng: Envy not * the man who prospereth in his way; the man who doth unjust things.

Day2.ant: Brácchia peccatórum * conteréntur, confírmat autem justos Dóminus.
Day2.antEng: The arms of the wicked * shall be broken in pieces; but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

Day2.v: Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam ejus.
Day2.r: Exaltábit te, ut hereditáte cápias terram.
Day2.vEng: Expect the Lord and keep his way.
Day2.rEng: He will exalt thee to inherit the land.

Day2.ant: Ne in ira tua * corrípias me, Dómine.
Day2.antEng: O Lord, * do not chastise me in thy wrath.

Day2.ant: Inténde in adjutórium meum, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
Day2.antEng: Attend unto my help, * O Lord, the God of my salvation.

Day2.ant: Ámove, Dómine, * a me plagas tuas.
Day2.antEng: Remove, O Lord, * thy scourges from me.

Day2.v: Deus, ne síleas a me, remítte mihi.
Day2.r: Quóniam íncola ego sum apud te et peregrínus.
Day2.vEng: O Lord, be not thou silent, forgive me.
Day2.rEng: For I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner.

Day3.ant: Speciósus forma * præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
Day3.antEng: Thou art beautiful * above the sons of men: grace is poured abroad in thy lips.

Day3.ant: Confitebúntur tibi * pópuli Deus in ætérnum.
Day3.antEng: Let people confess to thee, * O God, forever.
Our God * is our helper in troubles.

Day3.vEng: The Lord of armies is with us.
Day3.rEng: The God of Jacob is our protector.

Day3.ant: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis in civitáte Dei nostri.
Day3.antEng: Great is the Lord * and exceedingly to be praised in the city of our God.

Day3.ant: Os meum loquétur * sapiéntiam: et meditátio cordis mei prudéntiam.
Day3.antEng: My mouth shall speak * wisdom: and the meditation of my heart understanding.

Day3.ant: Ne timúeris * cum dívite non descéndet in sepúlcrum glória ejus.
Day3.antEng: Be not thou afraid * the things which made him rich, or his glory shall not descend with him to the sepulchre.

Day3.v: Deus rédimet ánimam meam de manu ínferi.
Day3.vEng: God will redeem my soul from the hand of hell.

Day3.antEng: The God of gods, * the Lord hath spoken.
Understand these things, * you that forget God.

Day3.ant: Acceptábis sacrifícium * justítiæ super altáre tuum, Dómine.
Day3.antEng: Thou shalt accept the sacrifice * of justice, upon thy altar, O Lord.

Day3.v: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam.
Day3.vEng: To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness.
Day3.rEng: And the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

Day31.ant: Speciósus forma * præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
Day31.antEng: Thou art beautiful * above the sons of men: grace is poured abroad in thy lips.

Day31.ant: Confitebúntur tibi * pópuli, Deus, in ætérnum.
Day31.antEng: Let people confess to thee, * O God, forever.
Our God * is our helper in troubles.

Day31.vEng: The Lord of armies is with us.
Day31.rEng: The God of Jacob is our protector.

Day31.ant: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis in civitáte Dei nostri.
Day31.antEng: Great is the Lord, * and exceedingly to be praised in the city of our God.

Day31.ant: Os meum loquétur * sapiéntiam: et meditátio cordis mei prudéntiam.
Day31.antEng: My mouth shall speak  * wisdom: and the meditation of my heart understanding.

Day31.ant: Ne timúeris * cum dívite non descéndet in sepúlcrum glória ejus.
Day31.antEng: Be not thou afraid * the things which made him rich, or his glory shall not descend with him to the sepulchre.

Day31.v: Deus rédimet ánimam meam de manu ínferi.
Day31.vEng: God will redeem my soul from the hand of hell.

Day31.antEng: The God of gods * the Lord hath spoken.
Offer to God * the sacrifice of praise.
Understand these things * you that forget God.

Day31.r: Et illic iter, quo osténdam illi salutáre Dei.
Day31.vEng: The sacrifice of praise shall glorify me.
Day31.rEng: He comes to save His people.

Day4.ant: In Deo salutáre meum * et glória mea: et spes mea in Deo est.
Day4.antEng: In God is my salvation * and my glory: and my hope is in God.

Day4.ant: Vidéte ópera Dómini, * et audítam fácite vocem laudis ejus.
Day4.antEng: Behold the works of the Lord * and make the voice of his praise to be heard.

Day4.ant: Audíte, omnes * qui timétis Deum, quanta fecit ánimæ meæ.
Day4.antEng: Come and hear, all ye that fear God * what great things he hath done for my soul.

Day4.vEng: God hath not turned away my prayer.

Day4.ant: Exsúrgat Deus, * et dissipéntur inimíci ejus.
Day4.antEng: Let God arise, * and let his enemies be scattered.

Day4.ant: Deus noster, * Deus salvos faciéndi: et Dómini sunt éxitus mortis.
Day4.antEng: Our God * is the God of salvation: and the Lord of the issues from death.
In the churches * bless ye God the Lord.

Day4.r: Deus Israël dabit virtútem plebi suæ.
Day4.vEng: God is wonderful in his saints.
Day4.rEng: The God of Israel is he who will give power and strength to his people.

Day4.ant: Salvum me fac, * Deus, quóniam intravérunt aquæ usque ad ánimam meam.
Day4.antEng: Save me, O God * for the waters are come in even unto my soul.

Day4.ant: Propter inimícos meos * éripe me, Dómine.
Day4.antEng: O Lord, save me * from my enemies.

Day4.ant: Quǽrite Dóminum, * et vivet ánima vestra.
Day4.antEng: Look for the Lord * and your soul shall live.

Day4.vEng: I will praise the name of God.
Day4.rEng: And I will magnify him with praise.

Day5.ant: Suscitávit Dóminus * testimónium in Jacob: et legem pósuit in Israël.
Day5.antEng: The Lord set up a testimony in Jacob: * and made a law in Israel.

Day5.ant: Coram pátribus eórum * fecit Deus mirabília.
Day5.antEng: The Lord did wonderful things * in the sight of their fathers.

Day5.ant: Jánuas cæli apéruit * Dóminus, et pluit illis manna ad manducándum.
Day5.antEng: The Lord opened * the doors of heaven and had rained down manna upon them to eat.

Day5.v: Deus percússit petram et fluxérunt aquæ.
Day5.vEng: He struck the rock, and the waters gushed out.

Day5.ant: Deus adjútor * est eórum: et Excélsus redémptor eórum est.
Day5.antEng: God is their helper, * and the most high God their redeemer.

Day5.ant: Redémit eos * Dóminus de manu tribulántis.
Day5.antEng: The Lord redeemed them * from the hand of him that afflicted them.

Day5.ant: Ædificávit * Deus sanctifícium suum in terra.
Day5.antEng: God built * his sanctuary in the earth.

Day5.vEng: The Lord chose the tribe of Juda.

Day5.ant: Ádjuva nos, * Deus, salutáris noster: et propítius esto peccátis nostris.
Day5.antEng: Help us, O God, our Saviour, * deliver us: and forgive us our sins.

Day5.ant: Ego sum Dóminus * Deus tuus Israël, qui edúxi te de terra Ægýpti.
Day5.antEng: I am the Lord * God of Israel, who brought you out from the land of Egypt.

Day5.ant: Ne táceas Deus * quóniam inimíci tui extulérunt caput.
Day5.antEng: Be not thou silent, O Lord, * for Thy enemies lifted up their head.

Day5.r: Tu solus Altíssimus super omnem terram.
Day5.vEng: Let them know that the Lord is thy name.
Day5.rEng: Thou alone art the most High over all the earth.

Day6.ant: Memor fuit in sǽculum * testaménti sui Dóminus Deus noster.
Day6.antEng: The memory of thy testament * will live forever, O Lord our God.

Day6.ant: Auxit Dóminus * pópulum suum: et firmávit eum super inimícos ejus.
Day6.antEng: The Lord increased his people exceedingly * and strengthened them over their enemies.

Day6.ant: Edúxit Deus * pópulum suum in exsultatióne, et eléctos suos in lætítia.
Day6.antEng: The Lord brought forth * his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness.

Day6.v: Memor fuit Dóminus verbi sancti sui.
Day6.r: Quod locútus est ad Ábraham, púerum suum.
Day6.rEng: Which he had spoken to his son Abraham.

Day6.ant: Salvávit eos Dóminus * propter nomen suum.
Day6.antEng: The Lord saved them * for his own name's sake.

Day6.ant: Oblíti sunt Deum * qui salvávit eos.
Day6.antEng: They forgot God * who saved them.

Day6.ant: Cum tribularéntur * vidit Dóminus: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
Day6.antEng: And he saw when they were in tribulation * and he heard their prayer.

Day6.v: Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster.
Day6.vEng: Save us, O Lord, our God.
Day6.rEng: That we may give glory to thy holy name.

Day6.ant: Clamavérunt ad Dóminum * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
Day6.antEng: Then they cried to the Lord * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

Day6.ant: Ipsi vidérunt * ópera Dei et mirabília ejus.
Day6.antEng: These have seen * the works of the Lord, and his wonders.

Day6.ant: Vidébunt recti * et lætabúntur, et intéllegent misericórdias Dómini.
Day6.antEng: The just see and rejoice * and understand the mercy of the Lord.

Day6.r: Et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
Day6.vEng: Let them exalt the Lord in the church of the people.
Day6.rEng: And praise him in the chair of the ancients.

Pasch Ant Dominica.ant: Allelúja, * lapis revolútus est, allelúja: ab óstio monuménti, allelúja, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Dominica.antEng: Alleluia, * The stone was rolled back, alleluia, from the door of the sepulchre, alleluia, alleluia.

Pasch Ant Dominica.r: Qui pro nobis pepéndit in ligno, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Dominica.vEng: The Lord is risen from the sepulcher, alleluia.
Pasch Ant Dominica.rEng: He, who hangeth on the tree, alleluia.

Pasch Ant Dominica.ant: Allelúja, * quem quæris múlier? allelúja: vivéntem cum mórtuis? allelúja, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Dominica.antEng: Alleluia, * Whom do you seek, women? alleluia: the living among the dead? alleluia, alleluia.

Pasch Ant Dominica.vEng: The Lord is risen indeed, alleluia.
Pasch Ant Dominica.rEng: And hath appeared to Simon, alleluia.

Pasch Ant Dominica.ant: Allelúja, * noli flere, María, allelúja: resurréxit Dóminus, allelúja, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Dominica.antEng: Alleluia, * Do not weep, Maria, alleluia: the Lord is risen, alleluia, alleluia.

Pasch Ant Feria.v: Deus regeneravit nos in spem vivam, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Feria.r: Per resurrectiónem Jesu Christi ex mórtuis, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Feria.vEng: God hath begotten us again unto a lively hope, alleluia.
Pasch Ant Feria.rEng: By the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, alleluia.

Pasch Ant Feria.v: Deus suscitávit Christum a mórtuis, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Feria.r: Ut fides nostra et spes esset in Deo, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Feria.vEng: God raised up Christ from the dead, alleluia.
Pasch Ant Feria.rEng: That your faith and hope might be in God, alleluia.

Pasch Ant Feria.r: Et nos suscitábit per virtútem suam, allelúja.
Pasch Ant Feria.vEng: God has raised up the Lord, alleluia.
Pasch Ant Feria.rEng: And he will raise us up by his power, alleluia.

Minor Adv1.ant: In illa die * stillábunt montes dulcédinem, et colles fluent lac et mel, allelúja.
Minor Adv1.antEng: In that day * the mountains shall drop sweetness,  and the hills shall flow with milk and honey, alleluia.

Minor Adv1.ant: Jucundáre, * fília Sion, et exsúlta satis, fília Jerúsalem, allelúja.
Minor Adv1.antEng: Rejoice greatly, * O daughter of Sion, shout for joy, O daughter of Jerusalem, alleluia.

Minor Adv1.ant: Ecce Dóminus véniet, * et omnes Sancti ejus cum eo: et erit in die illa lux magna, allelúja.
Minor Adv1.antEng: Behold the Lord will come, * and all his Saints with him: and in that day there shall be a great light, alleluia.

Minor Adv1.ant: Omnes sitiéntes, * veníte ad aquas: quærite Dóminum, dum inveníri potest, allelúja.
Minor Adv1.antEng: All ye that thirst, * come to the waters: seek the Lord, while he may be found, alleluia.

Minor Adv1.ant: Ecce véniet * Prophéta magnus, et ipse renovábit Jerúsalem, allelúja.
Minor Adv1.antEng: Behold, there will come * a great Prophet, and he shall renew Jerusalem, alleluia.

Minor Adv2.ant: Ecce in núbibus cæli * Dóminus véniet cum potestáte magna, allelúja.
Minor Adv2.antEng: Behold in the clouds of heaven * the Lord is coming with great power and majesty, alleluia.

Minor Adv2.ant: Urbs fortitúdinis * nostræ Sion, Salvátor ponétur in ea murus et antemurále: aperíte portas, quia nobíscum Deus, allelúja.
Minor Adv2.antEng: Sion, the city of our strength, * a saviour, a wall and a bulwark shall be set therein: open ye the gates, because God is with us, alleluia.

Minor Adv2.ant: Ecce apparébit * Dóminus, et non mentiétur: si moram fécerit, exspécta eum, quia véniet, et non tardábit, allelúja.
Minor Adv2.antEng: Behold, the Lord shall appear, * and he shall not lie: if he make any delay, wait for him: for he shall surely come, and shall not be slack, alleluia.

Minor Adv2.ant: Montes et colles * cantábunt coram Deo laudem, et ómnia ligna silvárum plaudent mánibus: quóniam véniet Dominátor Dóminus in regnum ætérnum, allelúja, allelúja.
Minor Adv2.antEng: The mountains and the hills * shall sing praise before God, and all the trees of the country shall clap their hands: for the Lord God shall come into his eternal kingdom, alleluia, alleluia.

Minor Adv2.ant: Ecce Dóminus * noster cum virtúte véniet, et illuminábit óculos servórum suórum, allelúja.
Minor Adv2.antEng: Behold, our Lord * shall come with power, and give light to the eyes of his servants, alleluia.

Minor Adv3.ant: Véniet Dóminus, * et non tardábit, et illuminábit abscóndita tenebrárum, et manifestábit se ad omnes gentes, allelúja.
Minor Adv3.antEng: The Lord shall come, * and he will not delay; he will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will manifest himself to all peoples, alleluia.

Minor Adv3.ant: Jerúsalem, gaude * gáudio magno, quia véniet tibi Salvátor, allelúja.
Minor Adv3.antEng: Rejoice Jerusalem, * with great joy, for a Saviour shall come to thee, alleluia.

Minor Adv3.ant: Dabo in Sion * salútem, et in Jerúsalem glóriam meam, allelúja.
Minor Adv3.antEng: I will give salvation in Zion, * and unto Jerusalem my glory, alleluia.

Minor Adv3.ant: Montes et omnes colles * humiliabúntur: et erunt prava in dirécta, et áspera in vias planas: veni, Dómine, et noli tardáre, allelúja.
Minor Adv3.antEng: Every mountain and hill * shall be made low: and the crooked shall become straight, and the rough ways plain: come, O Lord, and do not tarry, alleluia.

Minor Adv3.ant: Juste et pie * vivámus, exspectántes beátam spem, et advéntum Dómini.
Minor Adv3.antEng: Let us live in justice and godliness, * looking for the blessed hope and coming of the Lord, alleluia.

Minor Adv4.ant: Cánite tuba * in Sion, quia prope est dies Dómini: ecce véniet ad salvándum nos, allelúja, allelúja.
Minor Adv4.antEng: Blow ye the trumpet * in Sion, for the day of the Lord is near: behold, he shall come to save us, alleluia, alleluia.

Minor Adv4.ant: Ecce véniet * desiderátus cunctis Géntibus: et replébitur glória domus Dómini, allelúja.
Minor Adv4.antEng: Behold, he shall come * the desire of all nations: and the house of the Lord shall be filled with glory, alleluia.

Minor Adv4.ant: Erunt prava * in dirécta, et áspera in vias planas: veni, Dómine, et noli tardáre, allelúja.
Minor Adv4.antEng: The crooked * shall become straight, and the rough ways plain: come, O Lord, and do not tarry, alleluia.

Minor Adv4.ant: Dóminus véniet, * occúrrite illi, dicéntes: Magnum princípium, et regni ejus non erit finis: Deus, Fortis, Dominátor, Princeps pacis, allelúja, allelúja.
Minor Adv4.antEng: The Lord shall come, * go ye out to meet him and say: a mighty Prince, of whose kingdom there shall be no end: God, the Strong One, Ruler, Prince of peace, alleluia, alleluia.

Minor Adv4.ant: Omnípotens Sermo tuus, * Dómine, a regálibus sédibus véniet, allelúja.
Minor Adv4.antEng: Thy almighty Word, * O Lord, shall come from the royal throne, alleluia.

Minor Adv42.ant: Ecce, véniet * Dóminus princeps regum terræ: beáti, qui paráti sunt occúrrere illi.
Minor Adv42.antEng: Behold, the Lord cometh, * the Prince of the Kings of the earth: blessed are they that are ready to go forth to meet him.

Minor Adv42.ant: Cum vénerit * Fílius hóminis, putas, invéniet fidem super terram?
Minor Adv42.antEng: When the Son of man cometh, * shall he find faith on the earth?

Minor Adv42.ant: Ecce, jam venit * plenitúdo témporis, in quo misit Deus Fílium suum in terras.
Minor Adv42.antEng: Behold, the fulness * of the time is come, when God sent forth his Son into the world.

Minor Adv42.ant: Hauriétis aquas * in gáudio de fóntibus Salvatóris.
Minor Adv42.antEng: With joy * shall ye draw water out of the wells of the Saviour.

Minor Adv42.ant: Egrediétur * Dóminus de loco sancto suo: véniet, ut salvet pópulum suum.
Minor Adv42.antEng: The Lord goeth forth * from his holy place; he cometh to save his people.

Minor Adv43.ant: Roráte, cæli, désuper, * et nubes pluant justum: aperiátur terra, et gérminet Salvatórem.
Minor Adv43.antEng: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, * and let the skies pour down the Righteous One: let the earth open and bring forth the Saviour.

Minor Adv43.ant: Emítte Agnum, Dómine, * Dominatórem terræ, de Petra desérti, ad montem fíliæ Sion.
Minor Adv43.antEng: Send forth the Lamb, O Lord, * the Ruler of the land, from the rock of the wilderness unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

Minor Adv43.ant: Ut cognoscámus, Dómine, * in terra viam tuam, in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
Minor Adv43.antEng: That thy way, O Lord, * may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

Minor Adv43.ant: Da mercédem, Dómine, * sustinéntibus te, ut prophétæ tui fidéles inveniántur.
Minor Adv43.antEng: O Lord, * reward them that wait for thee, and let thy prophets be found faithful.

Minor Adv43.ant: Lex per Móysen data est; * grátia et véritas per Jesum Christum facta est.
Minor Adv43.antEng: The law was given by Moses, * but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

Minor Adv44.ant: Prophétæ prædicavérunt * nasci Salvatórem de Vírgine María.
Minor Adv44.antEng: The Prophets foretold * that the Saviour should be born of the Virgin Mary.

Minor Adv44.ant: Spíritus * Dómini super me, evangelizáre paupéribus misit me.
Minor Adv44.antEng: The Spirit of the Lord * is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the Gospel to the poor.

Minor Adv44.ant: Propter Sion * non tacébo, donec egrediátur ut splendor justus ejus.
Minor Adv44.antEng: For Zion's sake * will I not hold my peace, until her Righteous One goeth forth as brightness.

Minor Adv44.ant: Ecce, véniet Dóminus, * ut sédeat cum princípibus, et sólium glóriæ ténuit.
Minor Adv44.antEng: Behold, the Lord cometh, * to sit among princes, and to inherit the throne of glory.

Minor Adv44.ant: Annuntiáte * pópulis, et dícite: Ecce, Deus Salvátor noster véniet.
Minor Adv44.antEng: Tell it out among the people, * and say: Behold, God, our Saviour cometh.

Minor Adv45.ant: De Sion * véniet Dóminus omnípotens, ut salvum fáciat pópulum suum.
Minor Adv45.antEng: The Lord, the Almighty, * cometh out of Zion, to save his people.

Minor Adv45.ant: Convértere, Dómine, * aliquántulum, et ne tardes veníre ad servos tuos.
Minor Adv45.antEng: Turn thee, O Lord, * at the last, and tarry not to come unto thy servants.

Minor Adv45.ant: De Sion * véniet, qui regnatúrus est Dóminus, Emmánuel magnum nomen ejus.
Minor Adv45.antEng: The Lord that shall rule * shall come forth from Zion, Emmanuel is his name, and his name is great.

Minor Adv45.ant: Ecce Deus meus, * et honorábo eum: Deus patris mei, et exaltábo eum.
Minor Adv45.antEng: Behold, he is my God, * and I will glorify him my father's God, and I will exalt him.

Minor Adv45.ant: Dóminus * légifer noster, Dóminus Rex noster, ipse véniet, et salvábit nos.
Minor Adv45.antEng: The Lord our Law-giver, * the Lord our King, he cometh and will save us.

Minor Adv46.ant: Constántes estóte, * vidébitis auxílium Dómini super vos.
Minor Adv46.antEng: Stand still * and you shall see the salvation of the Lord.

Minor Adv46.ant: Ad te, Dómine, * levávi ánimam meam: veni, et éripe me, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
Minor Adv46.antEng: Unto thee, O Lord, * lift I up my soul; come and deliver me, O Lord, in thee do I put my trust.

Minor Adv46.ant: Veni, Dómine, * et noli tardáre: reláxa facínora plebi tuæ Israël.
Minor Adv46.antEng: Come, O Lord, * and make no tarrying; loosen the bonds of thy people Israel.

Minor Adv46.ant: Deus a Líbano véniet, * et splendor ejus sicut lumen erit.
Minor Adv46.antEng: God shall come from Lebanon, * and his brightness shall be as the light.

Minor Adv46.ant: Ego autem * ad Dóminum aspíciam, et exspectábo Deum, Salvatórem meum.
Minor Adv46.antEng: Therefore I shall look unto the Lord, * I shall wait for God my Saviour.

Minor Adv47.ant: Intuémini, * quam sit gloriósus iste, qui ingréditur ad salvándos pópulos.
Minor Adv47.antEng: Consider how glorious is the one * who shall bring about the salvation of the peoples.

Minor Adv47.ant: Multiplicábitur * ejus impérium, et pacis non erit finis.
Minor Adv47.antEng: His kingdom shall increase, * and of his peace there shall be no end.

Minor Adv47.ant: Ego Dóminus * prope feci justítiam meam, non elongábitur, et salus mea non morábitur.
Minor Adv47.antEng: I, the Lord, have brought my justice near, * it shall not be afar off, and my salvation shall not delay.

Minor Adv47.ant: Exspectétur, * sicut plúvia, elóquium Dómini: et descéndat, sicut ros, super nos Deus noster.
Minor Adv47.antEng: May the speech of the Lord be awaited like rain: * and the Lord our God descend like dew upon us.

Minor Adv47.ant: Parátus esto, * Israël, in occúrsum Dómini, quóniam venit.
Minor Adv47.antEng: Let Israel be ready * to go out to meet the Lord, for he is coming.

Minor Completorium.name: Dominica
Minor Completorium.ant: Miserére * mihi, Dómine, et exáudi oratiónem meam.
Minor Completorium.antEng: Have mercy * on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer.

Minor Completorium.name: Feria II
Minor Completorium.ant: Salvum me fac, * Dómine, propter misericórdiam tuam.
Minor Completorium.antEng: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, save me for thy mercy's sake.

Minor Completorium.name: Feria III
Minor Completorium.ant: Tu, Dómine, * servábis nos: et custódies nos in ætérnum.
Minor Completorium.antEng: Thou, O Lord, * wilt preserve us: and keep us for ever.

Minor Completorium.name: Feria IV
Minor Completorium.ant: Immíttet Ángelus Dómini * in circúitu timéntium eum: et erípiet eos.
Minor Completorium.antEng: The angel of the Lord * shall encamp round about them that fear him: and shall deliver them.

Minor Completorium.name: Feria V
Minor Completorium.ant: Adjútor meus * et liberátor meus esto, Dómine.
Minor Completorium.antEng: Thou art my helper * and my deliverer, O Lord.

Minor Completorium.name: Feria VI
Minor Completorium.ant: Voce mea * ad Dóminum clamávi: neque obliviscétur miseréri Deus.
Minor Completorium.antEng: I have cried * to the Lord with my voice, do not forget to show mercy, O God.

Minor Completorium.name: Sabbato
Minor Completorium.ant: Intret orátio mea * in conspéctu tuo, Dómine.
Minor Completorium.antEng: May my request * come before thee, O Lord.

Minor Nona.name: Dominica
Minor Nona.ant: Allelúja, * fáciem tuam, Dómine, illúmina super servum tuum, allelúja, allelúja.
Minor Nona.antEng: Alleluia, * make thy face to shine upon thy servant, alleluia, alleluia.

Minor Nona.name: Feria II
Minor Nona.ant: Exsultáte, justi, * et gloriámini, omnes recti corde.
Minor Nona.antEng: Rejoice ye  just, * and glory, all ye right of heart.

Minor Nona.name: Feria III
Minor Nona.ant: Salvásti nos, * Dómine, et in nómine tuo confitébimur in sǽcula.
Minor Nona.antEng: Thou hast saved us, O Lord, * and in thy name we will give praise for ever.

Minor Nona.name: Feria IV
Minor Nona.ant: Deus meus * misericórdia tua prævéniet me.
Minor Nona.antEng: My God, * his mercy shall prevent me.

Minor Nona.name: Feria V
Minor Nona.ant: Invocábimus * nomen tuum, Dómine: narrábimus mirabília tua.
Minor Nona.antEng: We will call * upon thy name O Lord. We will relate thy wondrous works.

Minor Nona.name: Feria VI
Minor Nona.ant: Misericórdia et véritas * præcédent fáciem tuam, Dómine.
Minor Nona.antEng: Mercy and truth * shall go before thy face, O Lord.

Minor Nona.name: Sabbato
Minor Nona.ant: Ne tacúeris Deus, * quia sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me.
Minor Nona.antEng: O God, be thou not silent * for the mouth of the wicked man is opened against me.

Minor Prima.name: Dominica
Minor Prima.ant: Allelúja, * confitémini Dómino, quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus, allelúja, allelúja.
Minor Prima.antEng: Alleluia, * Give glory to the Lord, for his mercy endureth for ever, alleluia, alleluia.

Minor Prima.name: Feria II
Minor Prima.ant: Ínnocens mánibus * et mundo corde ascéndet in montem Dómini.
Minor Prima.antEng: The innocent in hands * and clean of heart shall ascend the mountain of the Lord.

Minor Prima.name: Feria III
Minor Prima.ant: Deus meus * in te confído non erubéscam.
Minor Prima.antEng: In thee, O my God, * I put my trust; let me not be ashamed.

Minor Prima.name: Feria IV
Minor Prima.ant: Misericórdia tua, * Dómine, ante óculos meos: et complácui in veritáte tua.
Minor Prima.antEng: For thy mercy, * O Lord, is before my eyes; and I am well pleased with thy truth.

Minor Prima.name: Feria V
Minor Prima.ant: In loco páscuæ * ibi Dóminus me collocávit.
Minor Prima.antEng: The Lord hath set me * in a place of pasture.

Minor Prima.name: Feria VI
Minor Prima.ant: Ne discédas a me, * Dómine: quóniam tribulátio próxima est: quóniam non est qui ádjuvet.
Minor Prima.antEng: Depart not from me, * O Lord, for tribulation is very near; for there is none to help me.

Minor Prima.name: Sabbato
Minor Prima.ant: Exaltáre, Dómine, * qui júdicas terram: redde retributiónem supérbis.
Minor Prima.antEng: Lift up thyself, O Lord, * thou that judgest the earth: render retribution to the proud.

Minor Quad.ant: Vivo ego * dicit Dóminus: nolo mortem peccatóris, sed ut magis convertátur et vivat.
Minor Quad.antEng: As I live, * saith the Lord, I have no pleasure in the death of the sinner, but rather that he be converted and live.

Minor Quad.ant: Advenérunt nobis * dies pœniténtiæ ad rediménda peccáta, ad salvándas ánimas.
Minor Quad.antEng: Behold now is the day * of repentance, to redeem sin, and to save the soul.

Minor Quad.ant: Commendémus nosmetípsos * in multa patiéntia, in jejúniis multis, per arma justítiæ.
Minor Quad.antEng: Let us prove ourselves * in much patience and fasting, by the armour of justice.

Minor Quad.ant: Per arma justítiæ * virtútis Dei commendémus nosmetípsos in multa patiéntia.
Minor Quad.antEng: With the armour of justice * and in the power of God, let us prove ourselves in much patience.

Minor Quad5.ant: Líbera me, Dómine, * et pone me juxta te: et cujúsvis manus pugnet contra me.
Minor Quad5.antEng: Deliver me, O Lord, * and set me beside thee, and any man's hand may fight against me.

Minor Quad5.ant: Judicásti, Dómine, * causam ánimæ meæ, defénsor vitæ meæ, Dómine, Deus meus.
Minor Quad5.antEng: O Lord, thou hast judged * the cause of my soul, thou the Redeemer of my life.

Minor Quad5.ant: Pópule meus, * quid feci tibi? aut quid moléstus fui? Respónde mihi.
Minor Quad5.antEng: O my people, * what have I done to thee, or in what have I grieved thee? Testify against me.

Minor Quad5.ant: Numquid rédditur * pro bono malum, quia fodérunt fóveam ánimæ meæ.
Minor Quad5.antEng: Did they not reward me evil for good? * For they dug a pit for my soul.

Minor Sexta.name: Dominica
Minor Sexta.ant: Allelúja, * tuus sum ego, salvum me fac, Dómine, allelúja, allelúja.
Minor Sexta.antEng: Alleluia, * I am thine, save thou me, O Lord, alleluia, alleluia.

Minor Sexta.name: Feria II
Minor Sexta.ant: In tua justítia * líbera me, Dómine.
Minor Sexta.antEng: Deliver me * in thy justice, O Lord.

Minor Sexta.name: Feria III
Minor Sexta.ant: Suscepísti me, Dómine: * et confirmásti me in conspéctu tuo.
Minor Sexta.antEng: But thou hast upheld me, O Lord, * and hast established me in thy sight for ever.

Minor Sexta.name: Feria IV
Minor Sexta.ant: In Deo sperávi * non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
Minor Sexta.antEng: In God I have put my trust * I will not fear what flesh can do against me.

Minor Sexta.name: Feria V
Minor Sexta.ant: Memor esto * congregatiónis tuæ, Dómine, quam possedísti ab inítio.
Minor Sexta.antEng: Remember * thy congregation, which thou hast possessed from the beginning.

Minor Sexta.name: Feria VI
Minor Sexta.ant: Beáti, qui hábitant * in domo tua, Dómine.
Minor Sexta.antEng: Blessed are they * that dwell in thy house, O Lord.

Minor Sexta.name: Sabbato
Minor Sexta.ant: Dómine, Deus meus * magnificátus es veheménter.
Minor Sexta.antEng: O Lord, my God, * thou art exceedingly great.

Minor Tertia.name: Dominica
Minor Tertia.ant: Allelúja, * deduc me, Dómine, in sémitam mandatórum tuórum, allelúja, allelúja.
Minor Tertia.antEng: Alleluia, * Lead me into the path of thy commandments, alleluia, alleluia.

Minor Tertia.name: Feria II
Minor Tertia.ant: Illuminátio mea * et salus mea Dóminus.
Minor Tertia.antEng: My light * and my salvation is the Lord.

Minor Tertia.name: Feria III
Minor Tertia.ant: Respéxit me * et exaudívit deprecatiónem meam Dóminus.
Minor Tertia.antEng: The Lord hath heard * my supplication: the Lord hath received my prayer.

Minor Tertia.name: Feria IV
Minor Tertia.ant: Deus ádjuvat me: * et Dóminus suscéptor est ánimæ meæ.
Minor Tertia.antEng: For behold God is my helper: * and the Lord is the protector of my soul.

Minor Tertia.name: Feria V
Minor Tertia.ant: Quam bonus * Israël Deus, his, qui recto sunt corde.
Minor Tertia.antEng: How good is God * to Israel, to them that are of a right heart!

Minor Tertia.name: Feria VI
Minor Tertia.ant: Éxcita, Dómine, * poténtiam tuam, ut salvos fácias nos.
Minor Tertia.antEng: Stir up thy might, O Lord, * and come to save us.

Minor Tertia.name: Sabbato
Minor Tertia.ant: Clamor meus, * Dómine, ad te pervéniat: non avértas fáciem tuam a me.

Day6 Laudes2|1955.ant: Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
Day6 Laudes2|1955.antEng: In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

Day6 Laudes2|1955.ant: Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
Day6 Laudes2|1955.antEng: The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

Day6 Laudes2|1955.ant: A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
Day6 Laudes2|1955.antEng: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

Day6 Laudes2|1955.ant: In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
Day6 Laudes2|1955.antEng: The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

Day6 Laudes2|1955.ant: Laudáte * Dóminum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis ejus.
Day6 Laudes2|1955.antEng: Praise ye the Lord * according to the excellence of his greatness.
